purpose: AI-generated promotional artwork based on game vehicle/environment references; not raw gameplay screenshots

prompts.horizontal:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished HORIZONTAL 16:9 cinematic racing-game promotional banner, ideally 1920x1080 or higher at the same ratio. This is key art based on the actual game references, not a gameplay screenshot.
Input images: 1 = orange APEX Works car identity and geometry reference; 2 = blue/cyan AZURE car identity and geometry reference; 3 = red/ivory CORSA car identity and geometry reference; 4 = the actual forest race circuit environment reference ONLY, ignore and omit its HUD.
Primary request: arrange these three actual open-wheel monopost race cars in a thrilling, believable wheel-to-wheel racing composition for a game storefront banner.
Composition: very low front three-quarter tracking camera, wide lens without fisheye, camera slightly banked about 5 degrees, sweeping corner on the referenced forest circuit. Orange car is the large dominant foreground hero, pointing diagonally toward the viewer and the lower left; blue car just one car-width to its right and half a car-length behind, with a clearly visible gap between their wheels; red/ivory rival smaller behind them. All cars on asphalt, all four wheels correctly attached, coherent steering and suspension, no collisions. Show the complete hero car front wing and its four tires within frame with reasonable margins. Strong diagonal racing line, layered scale, readable silhouettes and immediate sense of competition. Use the wide frame deliberately, not as a collage. Upper quarter has calmer sky and soft distant trees suitable for optional later branding, no text there.
Style: polished cinematic 3D racing-game promotional render that stays faithful to the car designs, livery color blocking, number 27 and original APEX/AZURE/CORSA markings in the references. Retain the actual halo, narrow nose, open tires, wings and sidepods; do not substitute real-world licensed cars or sponsor liveries. Clean, visually coherent body panels.
Light and color: natural bright late-afternoon light, balanced restrained contrast, open readable shadows, detail in dark tires and navy paint, controlled highlights with no crushed blacks and no washed-out grey veil. Vibrant orange and blue against muted green forest, neutral grey asphalt, red/white kerbs, circuit fencing and a restrained grandstand in the distance.
Motion: directional blur on the track edges and distant background, subtle radial wheel blur; keep the hero body, livery and front wing crisp. A small physically plausible tire haze only; no explosions, no sparks, no rain, no fantasy neon.
No HUD, no menus, no UI, no title, no added tagline, no Nintendo logo, no borders, no watermark. Single cohesive landscape image, not multiple panels.
prompts.vertical:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished VERTICAL 9:16 portrait companion banner for this racing-game promotional campaign, ideally 1080x1920 or higher at the same ratio. Recompose for a tall canvas; do not simply crop the landscape reference.
Input images: 1 = approved horizontal campaign artwork, use its coherent visual style, car colors, forest circuit, balanced lighting and race moment as the reference; 2 = actual orange APEX Works car identity and geometry; 3 = actual blue/cyan AZURE car identity and geometry; 4 = actual red/ivory CORSA car identity and geometry.
Subject and composition: three actual open-wheel monopost race cars accelerating through the same forest-circuit bend. Extremely low front three-quarter tracking camera with a subtle 5-degree bank. Large orange hero occupies the lower half, nose angled toward the viewer and slightly left. Its entire front wing and all four correctly attached tires must fit inside the portrait canvas with safe margins; no clipped wheels or endplates. Blue rival is slightly behind and toward upper-right, with readable complete front wing and a clear wheel gap; red/ivory rival is further behind toward upper-left. The tall composition should form an energetic diagonal stack in depth, with clean silhouettes, strong relative scale and a sweeping racing line. All three cars sit on the same physical asphalt plane, with believable perspective, no floating, no collisions or intersecting parts.
Foreground: blurred neutral asphalt and red-white kerb sweeping toward the cars. Midground: the three cars dominate. Background: recognisable forest racing circuit, circuit fencing and restrained grandstand, natural sky. Keep the upper 20 percent relatively calm for possible later branding, but no text. Use the portrait space intentionally so the image reads clearly at storefront-thumbnail size.
Style and identity: cinematic polished 3D racing-game key art, matching Image 1 while staying faithful to the actual reference car silhouettes, halos, open tires, narrow noses, wings, sidepods, number 27 and APEX/AZURE/CORSA livery identity. Clean paint panels, no invented real-world sponsor logos or licensed car substitutions.
Lighting: same natural bright late-afternoon light as Image 1, warm edge light, balanced restrained contrast, readable tire and navy-paint shadows, controlled highlights; avoid crushed blacks, over-saturation or a washed-out grey veil.
Motion: background and track-edge directional blur, slight wheel rotational blur, crisp hero nose/body/front wing. Small plausible tire haze only, no sparks, crashes, rain, explosions or fantasy neon.
No HUD, no UI, no added title, no added slogans, no Nintendo logo, no borders, no watermark. Single cohesive portrait illustration, not a collage or a side-by-side sheet.
